name: Carrot (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Carrot (Daucus carota ssp. sativus) [Vegetables] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: 12797757, 676525, DTU, DUKE, MANUAL, PHENOL EXPLORER, S. R. Wild and K. C. Jones. STUDIES ON THE POLYNUCLEAR AROMATIC HYDROCARBON CONTENT OF CARROTS (DAUCUS CAROTA). Chemosphere, 23(2), 243-251, 1991, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 170393 (SR Legacy, Carrots, raw) - full macro/sugar/amino-acid/fatty-acid/vitamin/mineral panel
FooDB FOOD00245 (carrot record, qualitative compound coverage)
PMC10608851 - Chemical Composition, Functional and Anticancer Properties of Carrot (total sugars, total organic acids 1.07-2.79 g/100g FW, malate-dominant)
Springer Eur Food Res Technol doi:10.1007/s00217-021-03857-0 - carrot varieties UPLC (sucrose dominant sugar; malic/citric/isocitric/oxalic/fumaric organic acids)
Aprifel carrot nutritional sheet (sucrose ~4 g, glucose ~1.1 g, fructose ~0.9 g /100g)
PubMed 32083829 - carrot juice profile (L-malate predominant, citric 5-10x lower)
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy source is SUCROSE (3.6 g/100g) with free glucose+fructose (~1.1 g) and starch (1.4 g); the key growth-relevant fix versus the prior FooDB profile is the organic-acid pool (malate-dominant, citric/isocitric/oxalic/fumaric minor) which was entirely missing - reported here with the sourced aggregate (1.07-2.79 g/100g FW) but individual malate/citrate absolutes could not be resolved to single defensible figures, so those amounts are null. Most abundant amino acids are glutamat
curation_added: malic acid (predominant organic acid - entirely absent from prior profile)
total organic acids aggregate (1.07-2.79 g/100g FW)
quantitative amounts for sucrose/glucose/fructose/starch (were name-only before)
L-valine (amino acid missing from prior list)

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
